tagline.name: tagline
tagline.default: 'Excellence. Progression. Discipline. Respect. Knowledge of Self.'

description.name: description
description.default: 'Saturday lessons in English, Maths, Science and African History for children aged 5 to 16 in Tulse Hill, South London.'

school_travel.name: school_travel
school_travel.default:
'Buses: 2, 201, 415, 432 and 468.
Trains: Tulse Hill station is about 10 minutes’ walk. Walk up the hill towards Brixton and the school is on your left.'

school_history.name: school_history
school_history.default: 'Our school is named in honour of Afruika Bantu (Annette Blair, 1955–1999): a freedom fighter, activist, scholar, African History researcher and teacher.'

teaching_intro.name: teaching_intro
teaching_intro.default: 'We teach children aged 5 to 16 every Saturday morning in term time. We believe in academic excellence for all, and we want every pupil to aim high.'

teaching_tutoring.name: teaching_tutoring
teaching_tutoring.default: 'One-to-one tutoring is available for pupils who need extra support in a subject.'

quotes_feature_text.name: quotes_feature_text
quotes_feature_text.default: 'A people without the knowledge of their past history, origin and culture is like a tree without roots.'

quotes_closing_text.name: quotes_closing_text
quotes_closing_text.default: 'Up, you mighty race, for you can accomplish what you will.'

payments_intro.name: payments_intro
payments_intro.default: 'What it costs, and how to pay. Fees depend on how many children attend and on your work situation, so that the school stays affordable for every family.'

payments_fees_notes.name: payments_fees_notes
payments_fees_notes.default: 'If you no longer wish your child to attend, please give four weeks’ notice. Without notice, weekly fees continue to be owed while your child is absent.'
